mapper.select: select se.id as id, coalesce(se.display_title, se.season_name) as label, concat(se.season_year, ' · ', se.season_name) as subLabel from basket_season se where se.is_delete = 0 order by se.id desc

select d.id as id, d.division_name as label, d.platform_code as platformCode, d.platform_code as subLabel, d.format_snapshot_id as formatSnapshotId, ( select count(1) from basket_event_team et where et.division_id = d.id and et.event_team_status = 'ACTIVE' and et.is_delete = 0 ) as eventTeamCount from basket_division d where d.is_delete = 0 and d.season_id = #{seasonId} order by d.sort_order asc, d.id asc

select t.id as id, t.team_name as label, t.team_no as subLabel from basket_team t where t.is_delete = 0 and t.team_status = 1 and t.audit_status = 1 and not exists ( select 1 from basket_captain_grant g where g.is_delete = 0 and g.division_id = #{divisionId} and g.team_id = t.id and g.grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and g.active_unique_key is not null ) order by t.team_name asc, t.id asc

select m.player_id as playerId, coalesce(p.game_nickname, mp.nickname, concat('球员#', m.player_id)) as playerName, m.member_id as memberId, mp.nickname as memberNickname, (p.certification_status = 3) as certified, exists ( select 1 from basket_player_platform_account pa where pa.player_id = m.player_id and pa.is_delete = 0 and pa.account_status = 1 and upper(pa.platform) = upper(#{platformCode}) ) as hasPlatformIdentity, m.role_type as roleType from basket_team_member m left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = m.player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = m.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where m.team_id = #{teamId} and m.is_current = 1 and m.membership_status = 1 and m.is_delete = 0 order by case when m.role_type = 'CAPTAIN' then 0 else 1 end, m.join_time asc, m.id asc

select p.id as playerId, coalesce(p.game_nickname, mp.nickname, concat('球员#', p.id)) as playerName, p.member_id as memberId, mp.nickname as memberNickname, (p.certification_status = 3) as certified, exists ( select 1 from basket_player_platform_account pa where pa.player_id = p.id and pa.is_delete = 0 and pa.account_status = 1 and upper(pa.platform) = upper(#{platformCode}) ) as hasPlatformIdentity, exists ( select 1 from basket_captain_grant g where g.is_delete = 0 and g.division_id = #{divisionId} and g.player_id = p.id and g.grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and g.active_unique_key is not null ) as hasActiveGrant, case when exists ( select 1 from basket_captain_grant g where g.is_delete = 0 and g.division_id = #{divisionId} and g.player_id = p.id and g.grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and g.active_unique_key is not null ) then '该球员在此 Division 已有有效授权' when p.certification_status <> 3 then '未完成球员认证' else null end as cannotSelectReason from basket_player_profile p left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where p.is_delete = 0 and p.certification_status = 3 order by playerName asc, p.id asc
